name: pi
description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
one_liner: An open-source toolkit for building your own AI coding assistant or chat agent, including the parts that normally take months to build: talking to multiple AI providers, running tools, and showing a terminal interface.
buyer: A developer or small software company building a custom AI agent product who doesn't want to build the underlying plumbing (LLM connections, tool-calling, UI) from scratch.
business_use_cases: A dev tooling startup forks the agent-core package to build a specialized coding agent for a specific language or framework niche, skipping months of infrastructure work.
An internal platform team builds a company-specific 'ops agent' CLI on the same framework to automate internal workflows, reusing the unified multi-provider LLM API.
A consultant builds bespoke internal AI agents for clients on top of the toolkit, charging for the custom agent rather than the framework itself.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid custom-agent development services for companies who want a bespoke coding or ops agent built on this framework.

steal_this: This weekend, fork the coding-agent package into a narrow vertical assistant (for example a SQL-migration agent) and sell early access to teams in that niche.
